slides.texte_overlay:
signs you're more magnetic
than you think

people tell you things

friends and even strangers end up telling you things they never planned to say. people only open up to someone who makes them feel safe, and that is the rarest kind of pull.

silence doesn't scare you

you can sit in a quiet moment without rushing to fill it. calm people are magnetic because everyone else is nervous, and your calm quietly gives them permission to relax.

you remember the details

you remember the name of someone's dog or the exam they were worried about. tiny details prove you were really listening, and people never forget the ones who did.

you always have a story

you spend a few minutes a day learning something new: a strange fact, a moment in history, a painting. people lean in when someone always has something interesting to share.
slides.texte_sophia:
you always have a story

you spend 5 minutes a day learning one new thing: a strange fact, a painting. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and people lean in when you always have a story.

slides.texte_overlay:
you leave people better

people walk away from talking to you feeling a little lighter than before. that feeling is what magnetism really is, and it's built from small kindnesses, not big gestures.
